title: PTP descriptor/vendor-extension collections trust input counts beyond destination capacities
description:
Severity medium; confidence high; input bounds. Generic descriptor indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp.c:751-814 stores unbounded enum counts then writes value.sw.values[i]; capacity is1024 at indigo_ptp.h:325. Text enums only decode first16 but preserve larger target->count, later indexed through that count by update at1506-1512 and1556 onward; text storage is16 at header329. Sony duplicates numeric enum writes at indigo_ptp_sony.c:1072-1132, and its extension-info classifier1325-1349 appends received entries to1024-element local collections without caps. Canon indigo_ptp_canon.c:1036-1074 validates group count/size only by assert but does not validate group ID before indexing ex_func_group[16][1024], record extent, or item count; its updated pointer list has unchecked appends1071 and1176 despite outer record framing. The generic positive count/fixed-array issue and Canon group/list issue may merit separate follow-up records. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-11). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
